answer: Sybils cannot wander across identities without re-staking real value and redoing fresh work, so forging N identities costs N times the stake plus N times the compute, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique falcon-signed identity bond and solve a quartz-seeded proof-of-work tied to its hardware fingerprint, renewed every epoch. From sa0003's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
